# v0.3.0 — Learning-first curriculum

This release turns the repository from a reference-heavy collection into a guided course backed by runnable experiments.

## Highlights

- Eight progressive Chinese course modules with prerequisites, outcomes, self-checks, and a capstone.
- Nine lab guides mapped one-to-one to the C01–C09 transparent experiments.
- Machine-readable curriculum metadata plus `llm-theory-lab course` and `llm-theory-lab explain` commands.
- Strict validation of course chapters, lab guides, experiment coverage, versions, and internal links.
- Existing long-form theory and all 56 Transformer Circuits source entries retained as deep reference material.
- Removal of the completed one-time workflow and obsolete nested-project migration stub.

The release does not claim that toy results establish universal mechanisms in frontier models. Each lab states its evidence level and forbidden inference.
